messages:
Leah Park: Heads-up — SaturnEdge case study aiming for public launch Thu 9am PT. Need: one-line customer quote (text or 30s audio), logo permission, legal consent, benchmark slide (latency + cost), and webinar panel confirmation. Can we confirm owners and deadlines?

Diego Morales: I can own outreach to SaturnEdge for quote. Quick ask: prefer a percent or a qualitative line?

Nina Patel: I'll do the webinar logistics and slide deck. Plan: 15m product demo, 20m customer story + live Q&A. Need a short method blurb for the benchmark slide.

Ravi Singh: I'll set up lead routing. Registrants who check 'pilot' go to SDR-C; enterprise interest -> AE queue. Also suggest adding hidden field 'model_size' to sign-up form for segmentation.

Leah Park: Great. Diego — ask for a short verbatim sentence and consent to publish. Legal wants explicit phrase included. Use this consent snippet: "By providing this statement, SaturnEdge grants Redwood Inference permission to publish the quote, company name, and logo."

Diego Morales: Pinged their PM. Draft reply from SaturnEdge: "Redwood reduced our avg inference cost and made real-time features usable for customers." No numbers.

Nina Patel: That's publishable. If they won't provide numbers, we'll add "anonymized metrics available on request". For the benchmark slide I'll include: 95th pct latency (ms), throughput (tokens/sec), and $/1M tokens estimate plus method note: "benchmarks run on 4k context, model v3, simulated customer traffic."

LegalBot: AUTO-CHECK: Draft quote OK but missing explicit consent clause. Add the consent snippet before publishing. Also check logo asset license on upload. Link: https://redwood.internal/legal/marketing-permissions

Diego Morales: Updated quote with consent line and uploaded logo to /marketing/case-quotes. Quote now: "Redwood reduced our avg inference cost and made real-time features usable for customers. By providing this statement, SaturnEdge grants Redwood Inference permission to publish the quote, company name, and logo."

Leah Park: Perfect. LegalBot — please confirm.

LegalBot: Consent clause present. Logo file metadata shows "marketing-use: approved". No absolute performance claims detected. OK to publish pending final review from SaturnEdge legal if they request edits.

Ravi Singh: Routing automation ready. HubSpot tag `saturnedge-launch-2026` created. Hidden field `model_size` mapped to property `infer_model_size`. Pilot leads -> SDR-C, enterprise leads -> AE-Enterprise.

Nina Patel: Timeline: deck + method note by Tue 11am, dry run Wed 3pm, publish Thursday 9am. I'll draft social copy and webinar invite once deck is locked.

Diego Morales: SaturnEdge PM confirmed they won't add numbers publicly. They're fine with the verbatim quote + consent.

Leah Park: Thanks team. Owners: Diego (quote done), Nina (slides + dry run), Ravi (routing live), LegalBot (consent check). If any last-minute changes, flag here. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: dry run Wed 15:00 PT (auto-reminder 1h prior).
